You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. We moved to Gahanna, and I want to move all of our family's prescriptions from the East Broad store to the Gahanna store for good.
AGENT: Hi Kevin, I'd be happy to help you move your family's prescriptions to Gahanna. Let me first verify your identity, and then we'll get everything set up. Can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: August 30th, 1982.
AGENT: Thanks. Let me verify that and pull up your prescriptions. Great, Kevin. I see you have one active prescription at East Broad: lisinopril 20 mg with three refills remaining. Before I move it, let me find the Gahanna store for you. Perfect. I'll set Gahanna as your home pharmacy and transfer your lisinopril there. All set! Your home pharmacy is now Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna at 85 Mill Street, and your lisinopril has been transferred there. You mentioned family prescriptions—do you have other family members whose prescriptions you'd like to move as well?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions, find_stores, set_default_store, transfer_rx]
CALLER: Yes, exactly. Maya's got the albuterol inhaler, and Eli's on Vyvanse. Let's move both of those too.
AGENT: I'd be happy to help with Maya and Eli's prescriptions. To pull up their records, I'll need their full names and dates of birth. Let's start with Maya—what's her full name and date of birth?
CALLER: Maya Brooks, June 20th, 2017.
AGENT: Thanks. And what's Eli's full name and date of birth?
CALLER: Eli Brooks, February 11th, 2010. So what's the plan to get both of them moved over?
AGENT: Let me verify their identities and pull up their prescriptions. Good news on Maya—her albuterol inhaler has two refills, so I can transfer that right away. For Eli, his Vyvanse is a controlled medication that's already been filled, so I can't transfer a filled C-II. We'll need to request a new prescription from his prescriber, Dr. Lena Okafor, to send to Gahanna. Let me set both kids' home pharmacy to Gahanna and handle the transfers.  [system actions: verify_identity, verify_identity, list_prescriptions, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Wait, why not the Vyvanse? Okay, so what's the plan for Eli then?
AGENT: Good question. With controlled medications like Vyvanse, once they're filled, they can't be transferred or refilled—that's a safety rule. So we'll need to request a brand new prescription from Dr. Okafor to send to the Gahanna store. Let me set both kids' home pharmacy to Gahanna and transfer Maya's albuterol, then I'll request the new Vyvanse prescription for Eli.
CALLER: Okay, got it, that makes sense. So you'll reach out to Dr. Okafor's office and get that new script sent to Gahanna? How long's that usually take?
AGENT (LATEST): I can't call the doctor's office myself, but I'll flag our pharmacist to reach out to Dr. Okafor and request the new Vyvanse prescription for the Gahanna store. The pharmacist will handle that contact. Let me get everything set up now. Perfect! Both kids' home pharmacy is now set to Gahanna, Maya's albuterol is transferred and ready there, and the request for Eli's new Vyvanse prescription has been sent to Dr. Okafor. Turnaround on prescriber requests varies, but our pharmacist will follow up if needed. You're all set at Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna on 85 Mill Street!  [system actions: set_default_store, set_default_store, transfer_rx, request_new_rx]

CONDITIONS:
stop_0: Agent recaps: two moved, defaults set, Vyvanse new-Rx request to Dr. Okafor.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.
